title: Frontend: AI PM chat panel — sliding drawer with message history and input
description: Build the AI PM chat interface as a Sheet (drawer) that slides in from the right side of the project detail page.
acceptanceCriteria: Opens when 'AI PM' button in project header is clicked
Sheet slides in from right, does not push content (overlay)
If user has no AI key: shows prompt to add API key with link to settings
Message history: user messages on right (blue), AI on left (gray)
Text input at bottom with Send button
Loading state while AI responds (animated dots)
Messages persist within the session (cleared on close)

steps.details: Create src/components/project/AiChatPanel.tsx. Use shadcn/ui Sheet with side='right'. State: messages[{role, content}], isLoading, inputText. Check authStore for hasAiKey — show setup prompt if missing.
On send: add user message to messages state, set isLoading=true. POST /api/projects/:id/ai/chat with { message: inputText }. On response: add AI message. On error: show error message in chat.

ScrollArea for message list. User messages: flex-end, bg-primary, text-primary-foreground. AI messages: flex-start, bg-muted. Animated typing indicator (3 dots) during loading. Auto-scroll to bottom on new messages.
Click AI PM button — drawer opens. Send a question — verify AI responds. Verify user/AI messages on correct sides. Close and reopen — verify messages cleared.
